title: selenipedium × grande var. macrochilum
intro: Selenipedium × grande var. macrochilum, commonly known as the Golden Orchid, is a hybrid orchid species. This plant is known for its unique characteristics and potential health benefits, although more research is needed. There is limited information available on the specific health benefits of Selenipedium × grande var. macrochilum, but some reports suggest that orchid extracts may have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
